name: Morning Brush
implementation_intention: When I finish breakfast, I will brush my teeth before leaving the kitchen.
environment_prompt: Toothbrush visible on counter next to kettle.
reward_description: Fresh start feeling before the day begins.
temptation_bundle: Listen to a short podcast clip while brushing.

name: Afternoon Brush
implementation_intention: When my 16:00 alarm fires, I will pause and go brush my teeth.
reward_description: Clean mouth heading into the evening.

name: Evening Brush
implementation_intention: When I sit on the bed to wind down, I will go brush my teeth first.
environment_prompt: Toothbrush next to bedside glass of water.

name: Singing Practice
description: Vocal practice session in the van on the way to work.
implementation_intention: When I start the van engine, I will play a backing track and sing.
environment_prompt: Backing track playlist ready in phone music app.
reward_description: Feeling of creative expression before work.
temptation_bundle: Only play favourite songs during practice.

name: Cardio
implementation_intention: When my 07:00 alarm fires on Mon/Wed, I will put on my trainers immediately.
environment_prompt: Trainers left by the bedroom door the night before.
reward_description: Endorphin rush and sense of accomplishment.
temptation_bundle: Only listen to favourite playlist during cardio.

name: Calisthenics
implementation_intention: When I wake on Tue/Thu, I will go straight to the mat before checking my phone.
environment_prompt: Yoga mat left unrolled in bedroom.
temptation_bundle: Watch a YouTube fitness video while stretching afterwards.

name: Put Work Clothes Away
description: Hang or fold work clothes immediately after returning home.
implementation_intention: When I walk through the front door, I will go straight to the bedroom and put my work clothes away.
environment_prompt: Coat hook next to door as a visual trigger.
reward_description: Tidy room and mental transition out of work mode.

name: No Smoking in House Check-In
description: End-of-day check: did I keep the no-smoking rule inside?
implementation_intention: When I brush my teeth at night, I will reflect and log the check-in.
reward_description: Pride in maintaining a healthier living space.

name: Journal
implementation_intention: When it is 22:15 on Mon/Wed/Fri, I will open my journal before anything else.
environment_prompt: Journal left open on the bedside table.
temptation_bundle: Make a cup of herbal tea to enjoy while writing.

name: Sunday Meal Prep
description: Prepare and portion meals for the week ahead.
implementation_intention: When Sunday lunch is done, I will immediately start prepping for the week.
environment_prompt: Meal plan pinned to the kitchen noticeboard.
temptation_bundle: Put on a podcast or show while prepping.

name: Sunday Clothes Prep
description: Lay out and organise work outfits for the week.
implementation_intention: After meal prep, I will go to my wardrobe and choose outfits for Monday–Friday.

name: Social Interaction
description: Intentional social activity — meet someone, call a friend, or attend a social event.
implementation_intention: On Saturday afternoon I will reach out to or meet with at least one person.
environment_prompt: Saturday reminder: 'Who are you connecting with today?'
